transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I've been experiencing extreme energy levels and really rapid mood swings for several months now, but recently I started having some very strange thoughts and perceptions. It has gotten to the point where I felt I really needed to come in and seek some help.
Could you tell me a bit more about these strange thoughts and perceptions you've been experiencing?

It's really hard to talk about, but I constantly feel like I'm being watched and monitored by people I don't know. I've also started hearing strange voices whispering to me when I'm completely alone. This has been happening on and off for about a year now.
Have you ever experienced these voices or the feeling of being watched during times when your mood was completely normal and stable?

Yes, I have. There was a period of about two weeks where my mood felt completely normal and stable, not high or irritable at all, but I was still hearing those voices and feeling watched. It was really confusing because I thought those things only happened when my energy was super high.
When you have these periods of extreme energy, how long do they typically last, and do you experience other things like a decreased need for sleep or racing thoughts?

These high-energy periods have been lasting for about seven months, and I feel this constant, overflowing need to keep moving all the time. However, I don't really experience a decreased need for sleep or racing thoughts during those times.

No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling down or depressed. For the most part, my mood is either very high-energy or quite irritable, but never really low.
During these high-energy times, do you find yourself talking much faster than usual, making impulsive decisions, or feeling like you have special powers or abilities?

I'm not really sure if I talk faster, but I definitely make very impulsive and risky decisions, like spending way too much money. I also feel very strongly that I possess special, extraordinary powers and abilities during those times.
Out of the entire year you've been having these experiences, would you say you've felt these high-energy or irritable moods for the majority of that time?

Yes, I would definitely say so. I've experienced those high-energy and irritable moods for the majority of the year, specifically for about seven of the twelve months. It feels like that state has dominated most of my time lately.

No, I haven't been using any recreational drugs or drinking alcohol. I also haven't started any new medications during this past year.
Have you ever been diagnosed with any medical conditions, like thyroid issues, or had a physical illness that started around the same time as these symptoms?
No, I don't have any known medical conditions or thyroid issues. I haven't had any physical illnesses, and I'm not aware of any health problems starting around the same time as these symptoms.
How have these mood changes and the voices you've been hearing affected your daily life, such as your work, relationships, or ability to take care of yourself?

Things have been really difficult and chaotic lately because of the mood swings and the voices. It has made managing my daily routine feel very overwhelming. I'm just trying my best to get through each day right now.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient exhibits concurrent symptoms of a manic episode (sustained high energy, irritability, grandiosity, and impulsivity lasting 7 months) and schizophrenia (hallucinations and persecutory delusions). Notably, the psychotic symptoms persisted for a period of two weeks in the absence of any prominent mood symptoms, and the mood symptoms have been present for the majority of the total duration of the illness (7 out of 12 months), which meets the DSM-5 criteria for Schizoaffective Disorder, Bipolar Type.
